categories.name: Investigation
categories.trigger: Read-only question: how does X work, why was Y built this way, are we sure about Z, should we do X or Y.
categories.acceptanceExample: 解释现有导出功能怎样工作，只调查，不修改代码。

categories.name: Bug fix
categories.trigger: A reported defect to reproduce, root-cause, and fix with runtime evidence.
categories.acceptanceExample: 保存后重启内容丢失，请复现并修复。

categories.name: Perf issue
categories.trigger: A measured slowness to trace and improve against a baseline.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 这个查询耗时已测为8秒，请优化并比较基线。

categories.name: Hillclimb
categories.trigger: Sustained, scientific improvement of one metric against a target: loop hypotheses with before/after measurement, a decision log, and one commit per accepted win. Distinct from Perf issue, which is a one-off fix.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 持续迭代提高吞吐量直到达到目标，每次测量并记决策。

categories.name: Runtime forensics
categories.trigger: Diagnose a runtime symptom (leak, idle-CPU spin, glitch) from live instrumentation. The deliverable is a diagnosis, not a fix.
categories.acceptanceExample: 当前进程空闲CPU持续很高，请采集现场并诊断，先不修复。

categories.name: Trace forensics
categories.trigger: Diagnose a captured profiling artifact (cpuprofile, trace, spindump, heap snapshot) handed to you after the fact. The deliverable is a diagnosis, not a fix.
categories.acceptanceExample: 分析这份已有cpuprofile，给出诊断，不重新采集。

categories.name: Feature
categories.trigger: New or changed behavior, built from a named data shape.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 增加用户可见的导出功能。

categories.name: Refactoring
categories.trigger: A behavior-preserving change to structure or shape (rename, extract, inline, dedupe, move).
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 保持行为不变，将重复解析结构合并。

categories.name: Prototype
categories.trigger: A throwaway sketch to make a design or behavioral decision cheaply, or to settle an empirical fork by observing it instead of asking the human ("prototype", "mock it up", "try this layout", "sketch it to decide").
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 做个可抛弃原型比较两种布局。

categories.name: Visual parity
categories.trigger: Pixel-exact UI equivalence: matching two implementations or migrating a styling system.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 迁移样式时保持像素一致。

categories.name: Authoring or modifying a skill
categories.trigger: Writing or editing a SKILL.md.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 修改现有SKILL.md触发条件。

categories.name: Eval
categories.trigger: Testing how a skill, structure, or prompt change affects agent behavior before promoting it.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 测试提示词变更对代理行为的影响。

categories.name: Babysit
categories.trigger: Driving a PR or a stack to merge-ready: conflicts, review threads, CI.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 检查PR尚有何问题并处理CI与审查。

categories.name: Shipping
categories.trigger: The half after Babysit. Independently verifying a green stack, then landing the contiguous verified run bottom-up through `gh` by default or Origin when its CLI is available.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 独立检查绿色PR栈并合并。

categories.name: Autonomous run
categories.trigger: A long task to drive to completion without stopping ("run until done", "/loop until X").
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 持续执行这一个任务直到完成条件满足。

categories.name: Orchestrate
categories.trigger: A standing project handed to one coordinator chat: multi-day, many stacked PRs, dozens to hundreds of subagents, minimal human turns ("run this whole project", "own this migration until it lands"). Distinct from Autonomous run, which drives one task to a predicate. Work one agent could finish inside the session's budget routes there, not here, however program-shaped the phrasing sounds.
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 协调一个多日多PR项目。

categories.name: Autopilot-full
categories.trigger: A queue of independent PRs run to merged with full autonomy. One owner per PR carries build through merge, and the root swarm-verifies each PR before its owner merges ("autopilot this queue", "full autopilot", one-owner-per-PR programs).
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 自主完成这批独立PR直到合并。

categories.name: Autopilot-stack
categories.trigger: A queue of changes built and verified with full autonomy, delivered as one linear reviewed base-branch stack the operator lands ("autopilot-stack", "stack them, don't ship", "build the stack, I'll land it").
categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
categories.acceptanceExample: 构建线性PR栈，我来合并。

categories.fallback: Use the existing applicable Codex capability under project authorization; do not silently route to bug-fix or forensics.
